workstream: VALORIA STRUCTURAL FRAME / URBAN SUPPORT INTEGRATION v1
hypothesis: Replace the 2–4 largest grey technical support masses with one deliberately authored civic structural family: twin retaining bays around the ceremonial stair, a lower arcaded frontage, and a dedicated Cuartel terrace support. Arches, buttresses, cornices, parapets and recessed shadow should change the read from support geometry to capital architecture without competing with Hero Bastion.
stop_gate: direct comparison against canonical high-resolution reference
promotion_rule: Promote only if the dominant structural masses visibly change from technical supports/greybox to integrated Valoria architecture at first glance. CI/geometry count is insufficient.
anti_loop: One structural hypothesis only. No v2/v3 or placement/color micro-iterations after a valid visual candidate.
